main.description: A recorded or manually entered athletic activity. Where it is stored is its visibility: a public activity is a record in the athlete's repo, and a followers, mutuals or self activity is a record in the athlete's app.activitytracker.space.athlete space for that tier, never in the repo. Its URI is at://{did}/app.activitytracker.feed.activity/{rkey} wherever it is stored. Repo records are public: never include private locations. It holds only the fields whose detail category is at the activity's visibility: the others are on app.activitytracker.feed.activityDetails records in narrower tiers. When the start time is narrower, startedAt is the start of the activity's local day (by utcOffset); when the map is narrower, there is no polyline. At every visibility, polyline leaves out the athlete's privacy zones and hidden start and end (app.activitytracker.actor.privacyZones). The full-resolution track is never part of this record: it is an app.activitytracker.feed.activityTrack in the athlete's self space.

sport.description: Activity type, following Garmin's activity profiles plus types Apple Health, Health Connect and Strava track.

subSport.description: Refines sport (a mountain-bike ride, a treadmill run). Meaningful only together with sport; absent for the sport's generic form.

startedAt.description: The start, or the start of its local day when the start time is narrower than the activity.

avgSpeed.description: Millimeters per second (lexicons have no floats).

avgTemperature.description: Tenths of a degree Celsius (lexicons have no floats). May be negative.

poolLength.description: A pool swim's pool length, in centimeters.

cycles.description: Steps on foot, strokes swimming, rowing or paddling, pushes in a wheelchair, crank revolutions on a ride: the recording device's cycle count, with a run's strides doubled to steps.

avgStrokeDistance.description: Average distance per stroke, in centimeters.

utcOffset.description: The UTC offset where the activity started, in minutes east of UTC.

frontShifts.description: Front derailleur shifts by electronic shifting.

rearShifts.description: Rear derailleur shifts by electronic shifting.

grit.description: Garmin's mountain bike grit (trail difficulty), in tenths.

flow.description: Garmin's mountain bike flow (smoothness), in tenths.

polyline.description: Simplified route as a Google encoded polyline (precision 5), for feed/map previews. Trimmed by the athlete's privacy zones and hidden start and end; absent when nothing is left.

polylineGaps.description: Indices of the decoded polyline's points after which its line breaks, in ascending order: where no route was recorded between them, such as a combined activity's members recorded one after another or a stretch where a single recording lost its position. Absent when the line is unbroken.

sensors.description: Sensors paired with the recording device. Make and model only: never serial numbers or battery state.

dive.description: The dive computer's summary, for a dive.

media.description: Photos of the activity, in the order the athlete arranged them. An open union: later clients may add other kinds (such as video), which older ones keep as they are.

recordingOf.description: Legacy: another recording of the activity at this URI, such as a backup dive computer's: the same athlete's, and not itself a recording. Feeds show the activity once, and its view lists the recordings. A link to anyone else's activity, or to a recording, is ignored. Clients no longer write it: other recordings are combined (#combined), and existing groups are turned into combined activities.

combined.description: Present when this activity combines several of the athlete's own recordings of what was one activity, at the same time on different devices or one after another. Its figures, streams and track are built from its members, which are never rewritten. Feeds show it in place of its members.
The recordings an activity combines, and which of them each channel comes from.

members.description: The member activities, by the same athlete. A member that is someone else's, is itself combined, is claimed by an earlier-created combined activity, or has another visibility is ignored, and shows as an activity in its own right.

sources.description: For each channel, the members it is taken from, best first: at each moment the first member with a sample supplies it.

channel.description: A #streamData channel of app.activitytracker.feed.activityStreams, or one of position (the track and polyline), laps, legs, sets, lengths or dive (the dive summary, alerts, gas switches and tank pressures).

members.description: Members of the combined activity, best first. Empty when the athlete left the channel out of the combined activity.

dive.description: A dive's summary as the dive computer logged it. Every field is optional.

minTemperature.description: The coldest water, in tenths of a degree Celsius. May be negative.

bottomTime.description: Seconds from leaving the surface to the start of the final ascent.

surfaceInterval.description: Seconds at the surface since the previous dive.

closedCircuit.description: Breathed from a closed-circuit rebreather for at least part of the dive.

gases.description: Each gas breathed, in order of first use.

startCns.description: Central nervous system oxygen toxicity at the start, in percent of the limit.

endCns.description: Central nervous system oxygen toxicity at the end, in percent of the limit.

otu.description: Whole-body oxygen exposure, in oxygen toxicity units.

sac.description: Air consumption by tank pressure, adjusted to the surface, in millibar per minute.

rmv.description: Air consumption by volume (respiratory minute volume), in milliliters per minute.

tanks.description: One per tank a pressure transmitter was on.

startN2.description: Nitrogen loading at the start, in percent of the limit.

endN2.description: Nitrogen loading at the end, in percent of the limit.

descentTime.description: Seconds from leaving the surface to reaching the maximum depth.

waterType.description: The water the dive computer was set for; custom has its waterDensity.

decoModel.description: The decompression model the dive computer was set to; zhl16c is Bühlmann ZHL-16C with gradientFactorLow and gradientFactorHigh.

ppO2Warn.description: The ppO₂ the dive computer warns at, in millibar.

ppO2Critical.description: The ppO₂ the dive computer treats as critical, in millibar.

ppO2Deco.description: The ppO₂ limit for decompression gases, in millibar.

lowSetpoint.description: A closed-circuit rebreather's low setpoint, in millibar.

highSetpoint.description: A closed-circuit rebreather's high setpoint, in millibar.

safetyStopTime.description: The safety stop the dive computer was set for, in seconds; absent when the safety stop was off.

airTemperature.description: Tenths of a degree Celsius. May be negative.

altitude.description: The dive site's altitude above sea level, in meters.

noFlyTime.description: Seconds after the dive before flying.

desaturationTime.description: Seconds after the dive until fully desaturated.

highestPpO2.description: The highest partial pressure of oxygen breathed, in millibar.

site.description: The dive site's name. Never its coordinates: records are public.

image.description: A photo, re-encoded by the client (which drops its metadata, location included).

aspectRatio.description: Width and height in any unit, for laying out the photo before it loads.

diveGas.description: A breathing gas, in whole percents. Air is 21/0.

volumeUsed.description: Liters of gas used, at the surface.

volume.description: The tank's water volume, in milliliters.

sensor.description: A sensor paired with the recording device, such as a heart rate strap or a power meter.

model.description: Its model, e.g. "HRM 200"; absent when only its maker can name it.
